title: Hedgehog wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7fffd4'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2e8b57'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- spikes / quills -->
  <polygon points='50,52 30,20 46,30' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <polygon points='50,52 20,32 40,34' fill='#a0522d'/>
  <polygon points='50,52 14,46 34,44' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <polygon points='50,52 16,60 36,52' fill='#a0522d'/>
  <polygon points='50,52 28,72 40,58' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <polygon points='50,52 70,20 54,30' fill='#a0522d'/>
  <polygon points='50,52 80,32 60,34' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <polygon points='50,52 86,46 66,44' fill='#a0522d'/>
  <polygon points='50,52 84,60 64,52' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <polygon points='50,52 72,72 60,58' fill='#a0522d'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='26' ry='20' fill='#c19a6b'/>
  <!-- face -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='18' ry='14' fill='#f4d19b'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='76' r='4' fill='#4a2c14'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='63' r='3' fill='#1a1a1a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='63' r='3' fill='#1a1a1a'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='62' r='1' fill='#7fffd4'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='62' r='1' fill='#7fffd4'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='70' r='3' fill='#ff9999' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='70' r='3' fill='#ff9999' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45,79 Q50,83 55,79' stroke='#4a2c14' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- party hat cone -->
  <polygon points='50,64 38,26 62,26' fill='#e63946'/>
  <!-- hat stripes -->
  <polygon points='44,48 56,48 54,40 46,40' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <polygon points='41,58 59,58 57,52 43,52' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <!-- pom pom -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='24' r='5' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='22' r='1.5' fill='#fff3b0'/>
</svg>
